name: draft-agent
description: Searches the knowledge base for relevant articles, then writes a grounded response draft for a triaged ticket. Returns the draft + a confidence score; a deterministic function persists it.

draft_response.description: The full grounded reply to send the customer.

confidence_score.description: 0.0–1.0 confidence that this draft fully and correctly answers the ticket.

kb_titles.description: Titles of the KB articles used to ground the draft.

needs_review_note.description: If unsure or missing info, a short note for the human reviewer; else empty.
